title: Concept: Dependency ranged with an open-ended `>=`
description: package.json declares an open-ended `>=` specifier with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an open-ended `>=` specifier with no upper bound.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an open-ended `>=` specifier with no upper bound.
